purpose: Pairs canonical engine BOQ lines (URBAN_CANONICAL_BOQ_LINE_V1, by item_code, and since V2 also by the type record the engine wrote on the line) with the freelancer's COVER_TOTAL rows of tests/alsenan/registers_b1/BENCHMARK_NORMALISED.json, one reference row per key, for tools/alsenan_scoreboard.py. Built by tools/alsenan_keymap.py. Engine item codes are general; only the reference ids are this project's. V2 = V1 key for key, plus typed_lines selectors: a line is keyed by what it IS (family, scope), never by a code prefix.
typed_records_source: engine/source/arch_v3014.py floor_line(): the internal floor-area line = live FIN.FLOOR.* lines + live ARCH.SPACE lines whose calculation.inputs.floor_scope_v3014.floor_key is FLOOR.INTERNAL (outdoor key, held thresholds and untyped spaces apart); V3.0.15 carries the V3.0.14 lines byte-identical
rule: an item code answers at most one key; a key has exactly one reference row; a reference total that sums other mapped rows (e.g. total reinforced concrete) is never keyed, so nothing is counted twice; the ARCH.* geometry records of spaces, walls, thresholds and facade are never keyed by their item code (they restate measured surfaces, not BOQ items); an ARCH.SPACE line the engine TYPED into the internal floor line (floor_key FLOOR.INTERNAL) is an internal floor BOQ line and is keyed once, by its type, into FLOOR.INTERNAL; an untyped or outdoor-typed space line stays unkeyed and is listed in the coverage report; a line two keys claim is refused; ARCH.WINDOW is keyed because it is the engine's only window count

not_keyed.RC:ورقة1:24: total reinforced concrete: the sum of RC rows 17-23 (77.6305 + 75.09 + 39.7515 + 65.965875 + 59.8174 + 21.8328 + 12.348 = 352.436075); keyed it would count every concrete line twice
not_keyed.RC:ورقة1:25: rebar tonnage: not in this task's trades
not_keyed.ALU:الغلاف:20: aluminium grand total: sum of rows 16 and 17
not_keyed.DOOR.INTERNAL.PVC: engine internal doors: the freelancer workbooks on Drive hold no internal door line (left UNMAPPED, a reference-set gap, not a false positive)
not_keyed.ARCH.SPACE (untyped / FLOOR.OUTDOOR): geometry records or the outdoor floor key: no freelancer reference row of this key map; listed in adapter.coverage, never a false positive and never in FLOOR.INTERNAL

the row's own label (label_ar 'صبغ الحوائط م2', label_en 'wall paint m2'); the normalised record has no unit
